message:
Let me understand how the fuzzer harness works. Let me check the oss-fuzz build setup and how the target is invoked:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'cat /gt/_work/src/.clusterfuzzlite/build.sh 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; find /gt/_work/src -name "*.sh" -path "*fuzz*" 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; grep -r "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput\|fuzz" /gt/_work/src/src/ --include="*.cpp" --include="*.h" -l 2>/dev/null | head -20'</｜｜DSML｜｜>
